evidence_context_json: # SYNTHETIC DEMO MANUSCRIPT — NOT A REAL STUDY
## Anomalous-is-bad bias: an integrated evidence review
This deliberately synthetic manuscript exists only to demonstrate Callosum's unpublished-manuscript workspace. It reports no new participant data and must not be cited as research.
## Abstract

People can draw negative moral and social conclusions from visible facial differences. Workman et al. (2021) described this anomalous-is-bad stereotype, Rasset et al. (2023) tested gaze and humanity attributions, and He et al. (2024) tested whether complementary good-is-beautiful and bad-is-ugly stereotypes make moral character shape perceived facial attractiveness. We performed a synthetic random-effects meta-analysis of Hedges' g for demonstration only.
## Method
